TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_HIGH_LOW_COMBINATION.why: After both Lead and Answering Weapon hits on one target this turn, optional paid immediate native Shove; once per turn.

TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_ASYNCHRONOUS_SWING.why: Printed choice of normal die and type after attacks with both readied weapons, while holding Martial Focus.

TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_FOCUSING_DEFENSE.why: While Dodging with a readied Qualifying Pair, Balanced Defense grants +3 AC instead of +1; the increase ends when Dodge ends or the pair is lost.

TAL_AXES_HEADSMAN_S_CALM.why: 'When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP with an axe attack, you may regain Martial Focus if absent; once per short/long rest, Disadvantage on the next attack roll a nearby witness makes against you' has no modifier and modifies no named ability -- combat/ext/martial_axes.py applies it as an automatic after_hit policy keyed off this marker row (once-per-fight substitutes for once-per-rest; a fight rarely spans a real rest).

TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_DANCING_DISPLAY.why: 'When your Paired Strike hits a creature, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature' targets "Paired Strike", which is not a separately named ability anywhere in the authority (the pairing mechanic lives entirely in combat/factory_compiler.py's own weapon-generation code); combat/ext/martial_dual_wielding.py applies it via the attack_resolved hook, filtered to the Answering Weapon's hit (the game's own "paired_strike" event, per typed_executor.py's on_own_event call).

TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_DIZZYING_COMBINATION.why: Same "Paired Strike" targeting problem as Dancing Display; combat/ext/martial_dual_wielding.py applies the Dexterity save and Speed-halving on the same Answering Weapon hit.

TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_DEFENSIVE_WHIRL.why: Same "Paired Strike" targeting problem as Dancing Display and Dizzying Combination; combat/ext/martial_dual_wielding.py applies it on the same Answering Weapon hit, as the third on-hit Pair choice, spending 1 Martial Focus and giving that one creature Disadvantage on its attack rolls against the owner until the end of that creature's next turn (the sealed attack_mode_vs modifier with the END_OF_HOLDER_NEXT_TURN expiry the holder sweep removes).
